descriptors.label: Model Role Storage
descriptors.description: Where model selector role assignments are saved

descriptors.label: Auto Resume
descriptors.description: Automatically resume the most recent session in the current directory

descriptors.label: Enable Git Integration
descriptors.description: Show git branch, status, and PR information in the TUI and watch repository metadata.

descriptors.label: Dark Theme
descriptors.description: Theme used when the terminal has a dark background

descriptors.label: Light Theme
descriptors.description: Theme used when the terminal has a light background

descriptors.label: Symbol Preset
descriptors.description: Glyph set for icons and symbols (Unicode, Nerd Font, or ASCII)

descriptors.label: Color-Blind Mode
descriptors.description: Use blue instead of green for diff additions

descriptors.label: Composer Shape
descriptors.description: Visual layout of the input editor and status line

descriptors.label: Generation Rate
descriptors.description: Show a live generation tok/s readout: on the working row next to the session title, or in the native composer bar right after the thinking level, where the last reading stays between turns. Estimated from streamed deltas and corrected by the provider's billed output count as each message completes.

descriptors.label: Status Line Preset
descriptors.description: Pre-built status line configurations

descriptors.label: Status Line Separator
descriptors.description: Style of separators between segments

descriptors.label: Context-Reactive Line
descriptors.description: How the line between the left and right segments reflects context usage (box composer only)

descriptors.label: Session Accent
descriptors.description: Use the session name color for the editor border and status line gap

descriptors.label: Transparent Status Line
descriptors.description: Use the terminal's default background for the status line instead of the theme's `statusLineBg`. Powerline end caps are dropped because they need a contrasting fill to bridge into the surrounding terminal.

descriptors.label: Compact Thinking Level
descriptors.description: Show the thinking level as a single icon on the model name instead of a separate ` · <level>` suffix; in Tern's composer, as the model chip's icon instead of a separate chip (click the icon to cycle it).

descriptors.label: Show Hook Status
descriptors.description: Display hook status messages below the status line

descriptors.label: Show Inline Images
descriptors.description: Render images inline in the terminal

descriptors.label: Auto-Resize Images
descriptors.description: Resize large images to 2000x2000 max for better model compatibility

descriptors.label: Block Images
descriptors.description: Prevent images from being sent to LLM providers

descriptors.label: Resize Scrollback
descriptors.description: How a settled terminal resize refreshes transcript rows retained in terminal scrollback

descriptors.label: Complete Scrollback
descriptors.description: Send transcript rows pushed off screen by a growing HUD or dialog straight to scrollback; when it shrinks, blank rows sit between the transcript and the input until new output fills them

descriptors.label: Native Terminal Progress
descriptors.description: Emit OSC 9;4 indeterminate progress while the agent or context maintenance is running (always on in Tern)

descriptors.label: Program Status (OSC 7501)
descriptors.description: Report whether the agent is working, waiting on you, done, or failed over OSC 7501, for terminal tab indicators and agent inboxes

descriptors.label: Large Headings (Kitty)
descriptors.description: Render Markdown H1 headings at 2x scale using Kitty's OSC 66 text-sizing protocol. Only takes effect on Kitty terminals; ignored everywhere else. Off by default.

descriptors.label: Render Mermaid Diagrams
descriptors.description: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as ASCII diagrams

descriptors.label: Render SVG Figures
descriptors.description: Invite the agent to draw diagrams and charts as SVG, rendered inline as images on terminals that show graphics

descriptors.label: Auto-Graph Tables
descriptors.description: Draw a chart under numeric tables in the agent's answers, in your theme's colors, on terminals that show graphics

descriptors.label: Agent Reactions
descriptors.description: Invite the agent to react to your message with an emoji badge on its bubble

descriptors.label: Codex Reset Fireworks
descriptors.description: Celebrate unscheduled Codex weekly usage resets and newly banked saved resets with a top-third fireworks overlay that remains until Esc

descriptors.label: Terminal Title Run State
descriptors.description: Show the agent run state in the terminal title's separator — an animated spinner while working (a static ':' under WSL), '>' when it's your turn, '!' when the agent is waiting on you

descriptors.label: Terminal Title Spinner
descriptors.description: Glyph set for the working-state spinner in the terminal title — braille sweep, filling moon, single-dot cycle, or ASCII-safe line

descriptors.label: Terminal Hyperlinks
descriptors.description: Wrap paths and URLs in OSC 8 hyperlinks for terminal-native click-to-open (auto: detect support; off: never; always: unconditional)

descriptors.label: Mouse Click-to-Focus
descriptors.description: Capture mouse clicks in the main session so live subagent cards and HUD rows focus on click, with a hover highlight on the target. Native text selection becomes Shift+drag and wheel scroll becomes Shift+wheel while on

descriptors.label: Tight Layout
descriptors.description: Remove the 1-character horizontal padding from the left and right of the terminal output

descriptors.label: Shimmer
descriptors.description: Animation style for working/loading messages

descriptors.label: Pinned Agents
descriptors.description: Pinned live-agent jump list above the editor (off hides it; collapsed shows a few rows with an expander; full lists all)

descriptors.label: Subagent Live Preview
descriptors.description: Show each pinned subagent's current (or most recent) tool call beneath its row

descriptors.label: Smooth Streaming
descriptors.description: Reveal assistant text and streamed tool input smoothly while chunks arrive

descriptors.label: Hide Tool Activity
descriptors.description: Hide model-initiated tool calls and results from the transcript

descriptors.label: Show Token Usage
descriptors.description: Show per-turn token usage on assistant messages

descriptors.label: Show Turn Time
descriptors.description: Show the total prompt-to-yield time (including tool calls) on assistant message usage rows

descriptors.label: Cache Miss Marker
descriptors.description: Show a divider after an assistant turn whose request lost (missed) the prompt cache

descriptors.label: Collapse Compacted History
descriptors.description: Collapse pre-compaction history behind the summary divider on the live transcript; disable to keep the full transcript inline with dividers at each compaction point

descriptors.label: Show Hardware Cursor
descriptors.description: Show terminal cursor for IME support

descriptors.label: IME-Safe Prompt Layout
descriptors.description: Move the prompt's bottom border to a separate row so macOS IME preedit cannot displace it

descriptors.label: Steering Mode
descriptors.description: How to process queued messages while agent is working

descriptors.label: Follow-Up Mode
descriptors.description: How to drain follow-up messages after a turn completes

descriptors.label: Interrupt Mode
descriptors.description: When steering messages interrupt tool execution

descriptors.label: Vim Editing Mode
descriptors.description: Modal prompt editing. Esc leaves Insert mode; Normal mode has hjkl, 0, $, ^, w, b, e, gg, G, counts, x/D/C, dd/yy, p and u; operators take motions or text objects (diw, ca(, dap); v/V start a Visual selection that y copies and d deletes

descriptors.label: Vim Mode Indicator
descriptors.description: How the current Vim mode appears in the status line

descriptors.label: Loop Mode
descriptors.description: What happens between /loop iterations before re-submitting the prompt

descriptors.label: Loop Condition Timeout (ms)
descriptors.description: Max wait for a `/loop --while` / `--until` condition command before treating it as broken and stopping the loop. Set to 0 to wait indefinitely

descriptors.label: Recall Cleared Drafts
descriptors.description: Keep drafts cleared with Ctrl+C in local Up/Down history until exit; disabling affects future clears

descriptors.label: Double-Escape Action
descriptors.description: What pressing Esc twice with an empty editor does: open the transcript rewind selector, open the session tree, or nothing

descriptors.label: Bare Exit on Empty Session
descriptors.description: Submitting exactly `exit`, `quit`, or `q` (any case) before the first message quits instead of prompting the model

descriptors.label: Bare Slash Commands
descriptors.description: Submitting exactly a command name without the leading `/` (e.g. `model`, `compact`) runs that slash command; once the session has messages, press Enter twice to confirm

descriptors.label: Session Tree Filter
descriptors.description: Default filter mode when opening the session tree

descriptors.label: Autocomplete Items
descriptors.description: Max visible items in autocomplete dropdown (3-20)

descriptors.label: Typo Detection (macOS)
descriptors.description: Mark misspelled prompt words with the active macOS dictionaries

descriptors.label: Word Autocomplete
descriptors.description: Show predicted word completions as inline hints: Tab accepts with a space, Right without

descriptors.label: Composer Predictions
descriptors.description: After a completed turn, ask the active model to predict your next message and show it as ghost text in the empty composer; Tab or Right inserts it without sending. Extra usage: every completed turn sends one more billed request over the whole conversation (counted in /stats)

descriptors.label: Autocorrect (macOS)
descriptors.description: Apply confident macOS spelling corrections after completed words

descriptors.label: Emoji Autocomplete
descriptors.description: Suggest emojis from `:name:` shortcodes and expand text emoticons like `:D` or `:-)`

descriptors.label: Large Paste Menu
descriptors.description: When a paste reaches this many lines, offer a menu to wrap it in a code block, wrap it in XML tags, or save it to a file. 0 disables the menu (large pastes still collapse to a [Paste] marker).

descriptors.label: Quiet Startup
descriptors.description: Skip welcome screen and startup status messages

descriptors.label: Show Startup Splash
descriptors.description: Show the full animated setup splash on normal interactive startup without rerunning setup. Quiet Startup still suppresses it.

descriptors.label: Setup Wizard
descriptors.description: Show newly added onboarding steps once per setup version

descriptors.label: Check for Updates
descriptors.description: Check for omp updates on startup

descriptors.label: Update Channel
descriptors.description: Update channel used by omp update and the startup update check

descriptors.label: Marketplace Auto-Update
descriptors.description: Check for plugin updates on startup

descriptors.label: Startup Changelog
descriptors.description: Choose whether update notes start as a summary, full details, or stay hidden

descriptors.label: Magic Keywords
descriptors.description: Enable hidden notices for standalone ultrathink, orchestrate, workflowz, jevify keywords

descriptors.label: Ultrathink Keyword
descriptors.description: Let standalone ultrathink request maximum automatic thinking and append its hidden notice

descriptors.label: Orchestrate Keyword
descriptors.description: Let standalone orchestrate append its hidden multi-agent orchestration notice

descriptors.label: Workflow Keyword
descriptors.description: Let standalone workflowz append its hidden eval workflow notice

descriptors.label: Jevify Keyword
descriptors.description: Let standalone jevify append its hidden bulk-judge classification notice

descriptors.label: Completion Notification
descriptors.description: Notify when the agent finishes a turn

descriptors.label: Error Notification
descriptors.description: Notify when the agent stops with an error

descriptors.label: Ask Timeout
descriptors.description: Auto-select the recommended ask option after this many seconds (0 disables). Also bounds cfg:// approval prompts; an unanswered approval denies the write instead of auto-selecting

descriptors.label: Ask Notification
descriptors.description: Notify when the ask tool is waiting for input

descriptors.label: Idle Recap
descriptors.description: Generate a brief LLM recap of where things stand after the terminal has been idle

descriptors.label: Idle Recap Delay
descriptors.description: Seconds to wait while idle before showing the recap

descriptors.label: Sleep Prevention
descriptors.description: Prevent the system sleeping during active sessions. Each level is cumulative — it adds the flags of all lower levels.

descriptors.label: Enable Prewalk
descriptors.description: Start on the active model, then switch to a fast/cheap model (default the 'smol' role) at the first edit/write after the plan nudge's todo list exists — the strong model plans, commits the todos, and starts the implementation before handing off. Overridable per session with --prewalk / --no-prewalk.

descriptors.label: Auto Prewalk
descriptors.description: Ask the native judge resolved through the 'judge' role whether each new top-level user task front-loads its hard reasoning. Needs a native judge; without one nothing is classified. Independent of Enable Prewalk.

descriptors.label: Auto-prewalk target
descriptors.description: Model or role (default '@smol') auto-prewalk hands off to at the first edit/write.

descriptors.label: Max In-Flight Requests
descriptors.description: Maximum concurrent LLM requests per provider id (for example "openai" or "anthropic"), shared across local OMP processes with this config root. Omitted providers are unlimited.

descriptors.label: Describe Images for Text Models
descriptors.description: When an image is attached to a model without vision support, save it under local:// and inject a description from a vision-capable model instead of dropping it

descriptors.label: Thinking Level
descriptors.description: Reasoning depth for thinking-capable models

descriptors.label: Hide Thinking Blocks
descriptors.description: Hide thinking blocks in assistant responses

descriptors.label: Expand Thinking Blocks
descriptors.description: Keep finished thinking blocks expanded instead of collapsing them when the turn ends

descriptors.label: Prose Only Thinking
descriptors.description: Omit code blocks from thinking summaries and replace them with an ellipsis

descriptors.label: Omit Thinking summaries
descriptors.description: Instruct upstream providers to completely omit thinking summaries from responses (where supported)

descriptors.label: External Thinking
descriptors.description: Private scratchpad; not shown to user. Disables supported GPT, Claude, and Gemini reasoning

descriptors.label: Loop Guard
descriptors.description: Enable automatic stream loop detection for model reasoning and prose

descriptors.label: Loop Guard Scan Prose
descriptors.description: Apply loop guard to assistant prose messages in addition to thinking logs

descriptors.label: Loop Guard Tool-Call Reminder
descriptors.description: When a Gemini reasoning stream emits many consecutive planning headers without calling a tool, interrupt it and inject a reminder to issue a tool call (requires Loop Guard)

descriptors.label: Tool-Call Loop Guard
descriptors.description: Detect consecutive identical tool calls across turns and inject a corrective steer

descriptors.label: Tool-Call Loop Threshold
descriptors.description: Consecutive identical tool calls required before the corrective steer is injected

descriptors.label: Tool-Call Loop Exempt Tools
descriptors.description: Tool names that may repeat consecutively without triggering the cross-turn loop guard

descriptors.label: Inline Tool Descriptors
descriptors.description: Render full tool descriptors in the system prompt and strip top-level/nested descriptions from provider tool schemas so descriptor text is sent once. Auto enables this for Gemini models and disables it otherwise

descriptors.label: Include Model in Prompt
descriptors.description: Surface the active model identifier in the system prompt so the agent knows which model it is

descriptors.label: Include Workspace Tree
descriptors.description: Render the workspace directory tree in the system prompt. WARNING: This can bust prompt caching across sessions when files are modified.

descriptors.label: List Skills in Prompt
descriptors.description: List available skills in the system prompt; disable to save context and toggle per-session with /skillful

descriptors.label: Personality
descriptors.description: Communication style rendered into the system prompt's personality block

descriptors.label: Temperature
descriptors.description: Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, 1 = creative, -1 = provider default)

descriptors.label: Top P
descriptors.description: Nucleus sampling cutoff (0-1, -1 = provider default)

descriptors.label: Top K
descriptors.description: Sample from top-K tokens (-1 = provider default)

descriptors.label: Min P
descriptors.description: Minimum probability threshold (0-1, -1 = provider default)

descriptors.label: Presence Penalty
descriptors.description: Penalty for introducing already-present tokens (-1 = provider default)

descriptors.label: Repetition Penalty
descriptors.description: Penalty for repeated tokens (-1 = provider default)

descriptors.label: Text Verbosity
descriptors.description: OpenAI Responses and Codex response verbosity (low, medium, or high)

descriptors.label: Service Tier — OpenAI
descriptors.description: Processing tier for OpenAI / OpenAI-Codex requests, and OpenAI-family models routed via OpenRouter (none = omit). Sent as `service_tier`.

descriptors.label: Service Tier — Anthropic
descriptors.description: Processing tier for Claude requests. `priority` realizes fast mode (`speed: "fast"`) on supported direct Anthropic models; ignored on Bedrock/Vertex Claude and via OpenRouter.

descriptors.label: Service Tier — Google
descriptors.description: Processing tier for Gemini (Google AI Studio + Vertex) requests, and Google-family models routed via OpenRouter (none = omit). Sent as the top-level `serviceTier` field.

descriptors.label: Service Tier — Subagent
descriptors.description: Service Tier for spawned task/eval subagents. Inherit = match the main agent's live per-family tiers (tracks /fast); pick a value to apply it to whichever family the subagent's model belongs to.

descriptors.label: Service Tier — Advisor
descriptors.description: Service Tier for the advisor model. None = standard processing; Inherit = match the main agent's live per-family tiers; pick a value to apply it to the advisor model's family.

descriptors.label: Retry Attempts
descriptors.description: Maximum retry attempts on API errors

descriptors.label: Max Retry Delay
descriptors.description: Maximum wait between retries, in ms. When the provider asks us to wait longer than this and no credential or model fallback succeeds, the request fails fast instead of sleeping (e.g. 3-hour Anthropic rate-limit windows). 0 disables the ceiling — to let the session auto-resume through provider-stated quota resets.

descriptors.label: Wait For Usage Reset
descriptors.description: When a provider reports usage-limit exhaustion with a reset time (5-hour or weekly quota windows on any provider), sleep until the reset instead of failing fast past retry.maxDelayMs. Waits are abortable (Esc) but also hold subagents, so leave off for unattended runs.

descriptors.label: Retry Model Fallback
descriptors.description: Allow retry recovery to switch to models in retry.fallbackChains after provider errors. Independent of Auto-Promote Context

descriptors.label: Fallback Trigger
descriptors.description: Which failed requests may switch to a configured fallback model

descriptors.label: Usage-Aware Fallback
descriptors.description: Use reliable coding-plan quota reports to prefer same-provider accounts, then configured fallback models, before a hard usage limit. Ordinary configured API keys are excluded.

descriptors.label: Reserve Margin
descriptors.description: Treat a coding-plan model as near its limit below this remaining percentage. Unknown or unmapped usage keeps the primary model.

descriptors.label: Reserve Policy
descriptors.description: What to do when every same-provider coding-plan account is inside the reserve margin.

descriptors.label: Retry Fallback Chains
descriptors.description: JSON object mapping model roles, model selectors ("provider/model-id"), or provider wildcards ("provider/*") to ordered fallback selectors, e.g. {"default":["openai/gpt-4o-mini"],"google-antigravity/*":["google/*","google-vertex/*"]}. Model-oriented keys apply whenever that model/provider is active, regardless of role; a "provider/*" entry keeps the failing model's id and swaps the provider. An id-prefixed wildcard ("openrouter/google/*") re-prefixes the failing model's bare id (google-antigravity/gemini-x -> openrouter/google/gemini-x) and, used as a key, matches only that provider's ids under the prefix. A fallback entry may carry an explicit thinking suffix ("provider/model:low", ":high", ":max", ":off"); a bare entry inherits the failing turn's effort, and "provider/*" entries always inherit.

descriptors.label: Fallback Revert Policy
descriptors.description: When to return to the primary model after a fallback

descriptors.label: Anthropic Server-Side Fallback (Fable 5)
descriptors.description: When a Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 request is blocked by Anthropic's safety classifier, retry it on Claude Opus 5 server-side (Anthropic `server-side-fallback-2026-06-01` beta). Opt-in — leaving this off preserves the pre-fallback behavior for every request.

descriptors.label: Ollama Cloud Max Concurrency
descriptors.description: Maximum concurrent Ollama Cloud subagent runs per process; 0 disables the provider-specific limit

descriptors.label: Web Search Timeout
descriptors.description: Hard timeout for each provider's search transport before web_search advances to the next fallback, in seconds (maximum 300)

descriptors.label: Antigravity Endpoint Mode
descriptors.description: Endpoint routing strategy for google-antigravity providers (chat, search, image, discovery)

descriptors.label: Fireworks Tier
descriptors.description: Serving path for Fireworks requests. Priority sends `service_tier: "priority"` for higher reliability during peak traffic at a higher price; Standard omits it. Fast (`-fast`) models ignore this — Fast is its own serving path.

descriptors.label: Tiny Model Device
descriptors.description: Inference backend for local tiny models (titles + memory): an ONNX execution provider, or `mlx` to download MLX weights and run them through mlx-lm on Apple silicon. Default uses CPU-only ONNX. The PI_TINY_DEVICE env var overrides this.

descriptors.label: Tiny Model Precision
descriptors.description: ONNX quantization/precision for local tiny models. Default uses each model's shipped dtype (q4); lower precision is faster, higher is more faithful. Ignored by the MLX backend (its repos are pre-quantized 4-bit). The PI_TINY_DTYPE env var overrides this.

descriptors.label: Auto Thinking Ceiling
descriptors.description: Highest effort the `auto` classifier may resolve. `xhigh` keeps the classifier one tier below the top, so only an explicit `ultrathink` reaches `max`; `max` lets a turn the classifier judges exceptional bill the top tier on models that expose it.

descriptors.label: Unexpected Stops
descriptors.description: Automatically recover when the assistant stops without a visible message. Smart also classifies text-only stops with a small model.

descriptors.label: Kimi API Format
descriptors.description: API format for Kimi Code provider (auto follows live model metadata)

descriptors.label: OpenAI WebSockets
descriptors.description: Websocket policy for OpenAI Codex models (auto uses model defaults, on forces, off disables)

descriptors.label: OpenAI Live Steering
descriptors.description: Deliver messages typed while a GPT-6 response streams into that response over the Codex WebSocket, instead of waiting for the next tool boundary

descriptors.label: Muse Code Stored Responses
descriptors.description: Store Muse Code results on Meta's servers so a turn whose connection drops is recovered instead of re-run. Stored runs keep prompts and outputs on Meta's side.

descriptors.label: Prompt Cache Retention
descriptors.description: Prompt-cache retention forwarded to providers that support it (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenRouter, OpenAI)

descriptors.label: Cache Warming
descriptors.description: Re-send the last request with a one-token output budget shortly before its prompt-cache entry expires

descriptors.label: Stream First Event Timeout
descriptors.description: Seconds to wait for the first model stream event; -1 uses provider/env defaults, 0 disables the watchdog

descriptors.label: Stream Idle Timeout
descriptors.description: Seconds a model stream may stay silent between events; -1 uses provider/env defaults, 0 disables the watchdog

descriptors.label: OpenRouter Routing
descriptors.description: Default routing-variant suffix appended to OpenRouter model IDs (overridden when the selector already names a variant)

descriptors.label: Live Voice
descriptors.description: Voice used by Codex-backed realtime voice sessions

descriptors.label: Local TTS Voice
descriptors.description: Kokoro voice used by the local TTS backend (American/British, female/male)

descriptors.label: Local TTS Speed
descriptors.description: Speaking rate of the local TTS backend (tts tool, omp say). 1 = normal; clamped to 0.5–2.5

descriptors.label: Speech Vocalization
descriptors.description: Speak the assistant's output aloud through the speakers as it streams

descriptors.label: Speech Vocalization Mode
descriptors.description: What to speak: all = assistant messages + thinking; assistant = messages only; yield = only the final message at turn end

descriptors.label: Enhanced Speech Rewriting
descriptors.description: Rewrite assistant output into natural spoken prose with the tiny/smol model before synthesis (describes code, drops links and markdown). Falls back to mechanical cleanup on failure

descriptors.label: Speech Vocalization Voice
descriptors.description: Kokoro voice used when speaking the assistant's output aloud

descriptors.label: Speech Vocalization Speed
descriptors.description: Speaking rate when reading the assistant's output aloud. 1 = normal; clamped to 0.5–2.5

descriptors.label: Fetch Provider
descriptors.description: Reader backend priority for the fetch/read URL tool

descriptors.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Saved Resets
descriptors.description: Spend saved Codex rate-limit resets automatically: restore an account blocked by an exhausted 5h or weekly window when a turn is stuck and no other account can take over, and salvage credits that are about to expire. unset asks before the first spend (with no prompt UI, it spends only a reset expiring within 5 minutes), yes spends without prompting, and no disables both checks.

descriptors.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Min Block
descriptors.description: Only auto-redeem when the natural unblock — the latest reset among the exhausted 5h/weekly windows — is at least this many minutes away (don't spend a scarce credit to save a short wait). Raise it (e.g. 360) to ignore 5h-only blocks.

descriptors.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Reserve
descriptors.description: Never auto-spend below this many saved resets (0 = the last credit may be spent automatically). Credits about to expire are exempt — a reserved credit that expires preserves nothing.

descriptors.label: Codex Reset Salvage Horizon
descriptors.description: With auto-redeem enabled, spend a saved Codex reset within this many hours of expiry when either chat window has meaningful usage. 0 disables early salvage; credits expiring within 5 minutes are still attempted regardless of usage.

descriptors.label: Claude Auto-Redeem Resets
descriptors.description: Spend eligible Claude Cedar or Juniper resets automatically. Cedar is spent only for covered limits; Juniper can only recover a sole 5-hour block. unset asks before the first spend (with no prompt UI, it spends only a reset expiring within 5 minutes), yes spends without prompting, and no disables blocked recovery and expiry salvage.

descriptors.label: Claude Auto-Redeem Min Block
descriptors.description: Only auto-redeem when the natural unblock — the latest reset among the exhausted covered windows — is at least this many minutes away. A 5-hour-only reset is never used for a weekly or model-scoped block.

descriptors.label: Claude Auto-Redeem Reserve
descriptors.description: Keep at least this many Claude resets banked (0 allows the last eligible reset to be spent automatically). The reserve applies to early salvage, but not to eligible resets expiring within 5 minutes.

descriptors.label: Claude Reset Salvage Horizon
descriptors.description: With auto-redeem enabled, use a server-selected Cedar reset within this many hours of expiry when its covered windows have meaningful usage. 0 disables early salvage; eligible Cedar or Juniper resets expiring within 5 minutes are still attempted regardless of usage or reserve. Provider limit requirements still apply.

descriptors.label: Append-Only Context
descriptors.description: Cache system prompt + tool specs and keep an append-only message log so provider prefix caches (DeepSeek, Xiaomi/SGLang, Anthropic) hit at maximum rate. Auto enables for known prefix-cache providers.

descriptors.label: OTLP Telemetry Export
descriptors.description: Allow OMP to export traces, logs, and metrics using OTEL_* endpoints. Changes take effect on the next launch.

descriptors.label: Enable Advisor
descriptors.description: Pair a second model (assigned to the 'advisor' role) that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.

descriptors.label: Advisor Sync Backlog
descriptors.description: Pause main agent until advisor backlog falls below threshold. Numeric values cap wait at 30 seconds; strict waits for all scheduled reviews without a wall-clock cap. Off disables catch-up delays. Abort, failure, and disposal release waits.

descriptors.label: Advisor Immune Turns
descriptors.description: After an advisor concern or blocker interrupts, route further concerns as non-interrupting asides for this many primary turns. Blockers are exempt from the cooldown.

descriptors.label: Advisor Continue Severity
descriptors.description: Minimum severity of an advisor note that wakes the agent after it finished with a final answer. Lower-severity notes stay as a card at the end of the transcript and reach the agent with your next message.

descriptors.label: Advisor Review Mode
descriptors.description: Default advisor cadence when no WATCHDOG.yml roster is present. turn reviews every primary turn; agent-end reviews only final yields.

descriptors.label: Advisor Review Interval
descriptors.description: Default advisor cadence when no WATCHDOG.yml roster is present: review every Nth eligible primary update. 1 = every update. Skipped updates are sent with the next scheduled review.

descriptors.label: Advisor Max Notes Per Update
descriptors.description: Maximum non-blocker advice notes accepted per advisor prompt update (1–32; UI offers 1–5 quick picks). Blockers are exempt.

descriptors.label: Advisor Evict Stale Results
descriptors.description: Before each review, replace the advisor's read/grep/glob output from older reviews with a short placeholder. The latest review is kept.

descriptors.label: Additional Workspace Dirs
descriptors.description: Extra workspace directories added to every session as additional roots (multi-root workspace). Managed live via /add-dir and /remove-dir. Paths resolve relative to cwd; absolute paths recommended. The agent is told these roots exist and can read/grep/glob them.

descriptors.label: Extra Context Files
descriptors.description: Extra instruction filenames loaded beside AGENTS.md. Use a JSON list of names, not paths, e.g. ["AGENTS.local.md"]; [] disables extras. Start a new session to load them.

descriptors.label: Auto-Promote Context
descriptors.description: Promote to the model's contextPromotionTarget on context overflow instead of compacting. Retry fallback switches are controlled by Retry Model Fallback

descriptors.label: Extended Context
descriptors.description: Use larger context windows where supported; may incur premium pricing. Off keeps default or standard-pricing windows

descriptors.label: Auto-Compact
descriptors.description: Automatically compact context when it gets too large

descriptors.label: Notes-backed context windows (experimental)
descriptors.description: Keep persistent notes and searchable raw history across context windows.

descriptors.label: Mid-Turn Compaction
descriptors.description: Check thresholds at safe mid-turn tool-loop boundaries before the next provider request; subagents always check, since their whole assignment is one turn

descriptors.label: Compaction Method Order
descriptors.description: Preferred fallback order for automatic context maintenance; unavailable or failed methods advance to the next choice

descriptors.label: Compaction Threshold
descriptors.description: Percent threshold for context maintenance; set to Default to use legacy reserve-based behavior

descriptors.label: Compaction Token Limit
descriptors.description: Fixed token limit for context maintenance; overrides percentage if set

descriptors.label: Save Handoff Docs
descriptors.description: Save generated handoff documents to markdown files for the auto-handoff flow

descriptors.label: Remote Compaction V2
descriptors.description: Use Responses streaming compaction for compatible remote compaction models

descriptors.label: Async Compaction
descriptors.description: Speculatively summarize in the background as context nears the compaction threshold, then splice the ready result in when the threshold is crossed

descriptors.label: Idle Compaction
descriptors.description: Compact context while idle when token count exceeds threshold

descriptors.label: Idle Compaction Threshold
descriptors.description: Token count above which idle compaction triggers

descriptors.label: Idle Compaction Delay
descriptors.description: Seconds to wait while idle before compacting; with a 1-hour prompt cache, compaction instead runs just before the cache expires

descriptors.label: Supersede Stale Reads
descriptors.description: Prune older read results when the same file is read again (cache-aware, runs every turn)

descriptors.label: Elide Uneventful Results
descriptors.description: Prune tool results flagged contextually useless (no matches, timed-out waits) once consumed (cache-aware)

descriptors.label: Snapcompact System Prompt
descriptors.description: Experimental: render selected system prompt text as dense PNG image(s) and attach to the first user message (vision models only). Saves tokens; loses prompt caching for imaged text.

descriptors.label: Snapcompact Tool Results
descriptors.description: Experimental: render large tool results, the newest one included, as dense PNG image(s) instead of text (vision models only). Saves tokens on accumulated search and command output; read results stay text unless the model is known to edit exactly from images.

descriptors.label: Tool Calling Mode
descriptors.description: Controls how tools are exposed to the model. Auto uses provider-native tool calls unless the selected model is marked as not supporting them, then falls back to the GLM owned dialect. Native forces provider-native tools; the other values force the named owned dialect.

descriptors.label: Snapcompact Shape
descriptors.description: Frame shape snapcompact prints text with (compaction archive and inline imaging). Auto picks a shape tuned for the current model.

descriptors.label: Branch Summaries
descriptors.description: Prompt to summarize when leaving a branch

descriptors.label: Memory Backend
descriptors.description: Off, local summary pipeline, Mnemopi SQLite, Hindsight remote memory, or Sharpshooter

descriptors.label: Sharpshooter Model
descriptors.description: Model selector for extraction/consolidation, empty = smol role

descriptors.label: Auto-Learn (experimental)
descriptors.description: After the agent stops, nudge it to capture lessons to memory and create/enhance isolated managed skills

descriptors.label: Auto-run capture at stop
descriptors.description: When on, auto-run one private capture turn at stop (uses extra tokens). When off, only standing auto-learn guidance remains.

descriptors.label: Mnemopi DB Path
descriptors.description: Optional SQLite DB path. Defaults to the agent memories directory.

descriptors.label: Mnemopi Bank
descriptors.description: Optional shared bank base name. Per-project modes derive project-local banks from it.

descriptors.label: Mnemopi Scoping
descriptors.description: global = one shared bank; per-project = isolated bank per cwd; per-project-tagged = project-local writes plus global recall visibility

descriptors.label: Embedding variant
descriptors.description: Local embedding model family. en = stronger English model; multilingual = cross-language model. Changing this rebuilds existing memory embeddings on next start.

descriptors.label: Mnemopi Auto Recall
descriptors.description: Recall local memories into the first turn of each session

descriptors.label: Mnemopi Auto Retain
descriptors.description: Retain completed conversation turns into local Mnemopi memory

descriptors.label: Mnemopi Polyphonic Recall
descriptors.description: Fuse recall with graph, fact, vector and temporal voices so linked memories surface without a keyword match

descriptors.label: Mnemopi Enhanced Recall
descriptors.description: Cache recall results for repeated and similar queries with identical options; any memory write clears it

descriptors.label: Mnemopi Proactive Linking
descriptors.description: Ingest new memories into the episodic graph as they are stored, linking them to related entities and memories

descriptors.label: Mnemopi Disable Embeddings
descriptors.description: Force deterministic FTS-only recall instead of vector embeddings

descriptors.label: Mnemopi Embedding Model
descriptors.description: Advanced: explicit embedding model id that overrides the variant. Leave empty to use mnemopi.embeddingVariant.

descriptors.label: Mnemopi Embedding API URL
descriptors.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint passed to Mnemopi

descriptors.label: Mnemopi Embedding API Key
descriptors.description: Optional embedding API key passed to Mnemopi

descriptors.label: Mnemopi LLM Mode
descriptors.description: Use no LLM, the online tiny model (the TINY role from /models, else @smol), or a remote OpenAI-compatible endpoint

descriptors.label: Mnemopi LLM Base URL
descriptors.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint for Mnemopi remote mode

descriptors.label: Mnemopi LLM API Key
descriptors.description: Optional LLM API key for Mnemopi remote mode

descriptors.label: Mnemopi LLM Model
descriptors.description: Optional LLM model name for Mnemopi remote mode

descriptors.label: Hindsight API URL
descriptors.description: Hindsight server URL (Cloud or self-hosted)

descriptors.label: Hindsight API Token
descriptors.description: Bearer token for authenticated Hindsight servers

descriptors.label: Hindsight Bank ID
descriptors.description: Memory bank identifier (default: project name)

descriptors.label: Hindsight Scoping
descriptors.description: global = one shared bank; per-project = isolated bank per cwd; per-project-tagged = shared bank with project tags so global + project memories merge on recall

descriptors.label: Hindsight Auto Recall
descriptors.description: Recall memories on the first turn of each session

descriptors.label: Hindsight Auto Retain
descriptors.description: Retain transcript every N turns and at session boundaries

descriptors.label: Hindsight Retain Mode
descriptors.description: full-session = upsert one document per session, last-turn = chunked

descriptors.label: Hindsight Mental Models
descriptors.description: Read curated reflect summaries (mental models) into developer instructions at boot. Loads existing models on the bank — does not write. Pair with hindsight.mentalModelAutoSeed to also auto-create the built-in seed set.

descriptors.label: Hindsight Mental Model Auto-Seed
descriptors.description: At session start, create any built-in mental models (project-conventions, project-decisions, user-preferences) that do not yet exist on the bank.

descriptors.label: TTSR
descriptors.description: Interrupt the agent mid-stream when output matches rule patterns (Time-Traveling Stream Rules)

descriptors.label: Judged Rules
descriptors.description: Ask the judge model role each `question` rule about completed replies, reasoning, and tool calls; a yes injects the rule as a warning

descriptors.label: TTSR Context Mode
descriptors.description: What to do with partial output when TTSR triggers

descriptors.label: TTSR Interrupt Mode
descriptors.description: When to interrupt mid-stream vs inject warning after completion

descriptors.label: TTSR Repeat Mode
descriptors.description: How rules can repeat: once per session or after a message gap

descriptors.label: TTSR Repeat Gap
descriptors.description: Messages before a rule can trigger again

descriptors.label: Built-in Rules
descriptors.description: Load the default rules shipped with the agent (override individually with ttsr.disabledRules)

descriptors.label: Disabled Rules
descriptors.description: Rule names to ignore entirely (applies to bundled defaults and your own rules)

descriptors.label: Edit Mode
descriptors.description: Select the edit tool variant (replace, patch, hashline, or apply_patch)

descriptors.label: Fuzzy Match
descriptors.description: Accept high-confidence fuzzy matches for whitespace differences

descriptors.label: Fuzzy Match Threshold
descriptors.description: Similarity threshold (0-1) for accepting fuzzy matches

descriptors.label: Abort on Failed Preview
descriptors.description: Abort streaming edit tool calls when patch preview fails

descriptors.label: Recover Inline Edit Payloads
descriptors.description: Execute edit payloads the model emits as plain text by converting them into edit tool calls

descriptors.label: Block Auto-Generated Files
descriptors.description: Prevent editing of files that appear to be auto-generated (protoc, sqlc, swagger, etc.)

descriptors.label: Enforce Seen-Line Guard
descriptors.description: Reject edits anchored on lines a prior read/search never displayed in full

descriptors.label: Record Parse Regressions
descriptors.description: Append full before/after source when an edit introduces an AST parse failure

descriptors.label: Auto-Repair Parse Regressions
descriptors.description: When an edit breaks a file's AST parse, ask the smol model to fix the broken region (validated by re-parse; falls back to a warning)

descriptors.label: Artifact Spill Threshold (KB)
descriptors.description: Tool output above this size is saved as an artifact; tail is kept inline

descriptors.label: Artifact Tail Size (KB)
descriptors.description: Amount of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact

descriptors.label: Artifact Head Size (KB)
descriptors.description: Amount of head content kept inline alongside the tail when output spills to artifact (middle elision). 0 disables — keep tail only.

descriptors.label: Output Column Cap
descriptors.description: Per-line byte cap for streaming tool outputs (bash, python, js eval) and `read`. Lines wider than this are ellipsis-truncated; remaining bytes up to the next newline are dropped. 0 disables.

descriptors.label: Artifact Tail Lines
descriptors.description: Maximum lines of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact

descriptors.label: Artifact File Cap (MB)
descriptors.description: Maximum size of the artifact file saved for streaming tool output (bash, python, js eval). Larger output keeps its beginning (up to 3 MB) and its most recent remainder, with a truncation notice between them. 0 = unlimited.

descriptors.label: Line Numbers
descriptors.description: Prepend line numbers to read tool output by default

descriptors.label: Default Read Limit
descriptors.description: Default number of lines returned when agent calls read without a limit

descriptors.label: Markdown Previews
descriptors.description: Render Markdown read results as formatted terminal Markdown previews instead of raw source

descriptors.label: Read Summaries
descriptors.description: Return structural code summaries when read is called without an explicit selector

descriptors.label: Prose Summaries
descriptors.description: Return structural summaries for Markdown and plain text reads

descriptors.label: Read Summary Body Lines
descriptors.description: Minimum multiline body or literal length before read summaries collapse it

descriptors.label: Read Summary Comment Lines
descriptors.description: Minimum multiline block comment length before read summaries collapse it

descriptors.label: Read Summary Minimum File Length
descriptors.description: Files with fewer total lines are read verbatim instead of structurally summarized

descriptors.label: Read Summary Unfold Target
descriptors.description: BFS-unfold elidable spans until the summary is at least this many visible lines. 0 keeps only the outermost elisions.

descriptors.label: Read Summary Unfold Ceiling
descriptors.description: Hard ceiling on summary size while BFS-unfolding. An unfold whose revealed lines would exceed this is skipped (that span stays folded) and unfolding continues with the remaining spans.

descriptors.label: Inline Read Previews
descriptors.description: Render read tool results inline in the transcript instead of summary rows

descriptors.label: Tool Approval Policies
descriptors.description: Per-tool approval policies. Set to 'allow' to auto-approve, 'prompt' to require confirmation, or 'deny' to block. Overrides are honored in every approval mode.

descriptors.label: Tool Approval
descriptors.description: Default approval behavior for tool calls. 'Always ask' auto-approves read-only tools only. 'Ask and remember' also asks before file reads, and can remember a file or folder. 'Write' auto-approves read and workspace-write tools. 'Yolo' auto-approves all tiers; user policy may still prompt or block.

descriptors.label: Todos
descriptors.description: Enable the todo tool for task tracking

descriptors.label: Todo Reminders
descriptors.description: Remind the agent to complete todos before stopping

descriptors.label: Todo Reminder Limit
descriptors.description: Maximum number of todo reminders before giving up

descriptors.label: Create Todos Automatically
descriptors.description: How strongly to push automatic todo-list creation after the first message

descriptors.label: Todo Auto-Clear Delay
descriptors.description: Delay before completed or abandoned todos are removed from the todo widget

descriptors.label: Glob
descriptors.description: Enable the glob tool for glob-based file lookup

descriptors.label: Grep
descriptors.description: Enable the grep tool for regex content search

descriptors.label: Grep Context Before
descriptors.description: Lines of context before each grep match

descriptors.label: Grep Context After
descriptors.description: Lines of context after each grep match

descriptors.label: AST Grep
descriptors.description: Enable the ast_grep tool for structural AST search

descriptors.label: AST Edit
descriptors.description: Enable the ast_edit tool for structural AST rewrites

descriptors.label: Find (semantic grep)
descriptors.description: Enable the find tool: natural-language search for files and line ranges, judged by the judge model role. Auto enables it only when the judge role resolves to a native TypeSafe jev model

descriptors.label: Debug
descriptors.description: Enable the debug tool for DAP-based debugging

descriptors.label: Services
descriptors.description: Enable named bash services and proc:// supervision for shared long-running project processes

descriptors.label: Speech Generation
descriptors.description: Enable the tts tool for on-device (Kokoro) or xAI Grok Voice speech-file synthesis

descriptors.label: Generate Image
descriptors.description: Enable the generate_image tool (text-to-image generation and editing). Exposed as an xd:// device when tools.xdev is on.

descriptors.label: Computer
descriptors.description: Enable the scriptable host-desktop eval prelude (screenshots, input, accessibility)

descriptors.label: Ratchet
descriptors.description: Enable the ratchet eval/hillclimb prelude; /ratchet turns it on for the current session

descriptors.label: Archive
descriptors.description: Enable the read-only archive eval prelude: prompt history, recent projects, past sessions and recaps

descriptors.label: Computer Display
descriptors.description: Active window's display (active), all displays (all), or a native display id

descriptors.label: Computer Screenshot Width
descriptors.description: Maximum screenshot width in pixels

descriptors.label: Computer Screenshot Height
descriptors.description: Maximum screenshot height in pixels

descriptors.label: Computer Background Fallback
descriptors.description: What window input does when its background route is unavailable: rerun it in takeover and return focus to your app (macOS; elsewhere plain takeover), or refuse, which also keeps the agent from taking the foreground or opening macOS menus itself

descriptors.label: Image Question Timeout
descriptors.description: Per-request timeout for the vision-model call behind read's ?q= image questions, in milliseconds. A stalled provider fails fast with a timeout error instead of blocking until manual abort. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.

descriptors.label: Checkpoint/Rewind
descriptors.description: Enable the checkpoint and rewind tools for context checkpointing

descriptors.label: Read URLs
descriptors.description: Allow the read tool to fetch and process URLs

descriptors.label: Obsidian Vault
descriptors.description: Enable the vault:// internal URL for reading and editing Obsidian vault content via the Obsidian CLI. When disabled, vault:// resolution is refused and the vault:// entry is omitted from the system prompt.

descriptors.label: GitHub CLI
descriptors.description: Enable the github tool (op-based dispatch for repository, issue, pull request, diff, search, checkout, push, and Actions watch workflows)

descriptors.label: GitHub View Cache
descriptors.description: Cache rendered issue/PR view output in ~/.omp/cache/github-cache.db so repeated reads are free

descriptors.label: GitHub Cache Soft TTL
descriptors.description: Within this window, cached issue/PR view rows are returned directly (seconds; default 5 minutes)

descriptors.label: GitHub Cache Hard TTL
descriptors.description: Past the soft TTL the cached row is returned and refreshed in the background; past the hard TTL it is dropped (seconds; default 7 days)

descriptors.label: Web Search
descriptors.description: Enable the web_search tool for live web results

descriptors.label: Security
descriptors.description: Enable OMP-native security scan planning, execution, and the read-only security:// resource namespace

descriptors.label: Ask
descriptors.description: Enable the ask tool for interactive user questions

descriptors.label: Intent Tracing
descriptors.description: Ask the agent to describe the intent of each tool call before executing it

descriptors.label: Abort On Fabricated Tool Result
descriptors.description: With in-band tool calls, stop the model immediately when it starts hallucinating a tool result mid-turn. Disable to let the model finish generating and discard the fabricated continuation instead.

descriptors.label: Experimental Speculative Execution
descriptors.description: Enable the discard-safe first slice: validated local reads through direct read calls and nested eval. Network requests, provider completions, and live filesystem writes are not part of this baseline.

descriptors.label: Speculative Execution Concurrency
descriptors.description: Maximum number of validated local reads allowed to run before normal dispatch.

descriptors.label: Max Tool Timeout
descriptors.description: Maximum timeout in seconds the agent can set for any tool (0 = no limit)

descriptors.label: Async Execution
descriptors.description: Enable async bash commands and background task execution

descriptors.label: Live Job Widgets
descriptors.description: Draw a live widget for each running background job (charts, bars, status grids derived from its output) in the wait card, the jobs pill and the jobs sheet. The `widget` model role (default: `smol`) writes one spec per job; updates need no further model calls

descriptors.label: xd:// Tools
descriptors.description: Mount rarely-used (discoverable) tools under xd:// device URLs driven via read/write instead of shipping their schemas on every request. Sessions whose explicit tool list grants read but omits write mount devices through a device-only write transport (only local:// scratch stays writable besides devices). Disable to expose every enabled tool top-level.

descriptors.label: xd:// Prompt Docs
descriptors.description: Choose which mounted-device docs and schemas are inlined in the system prompt. Built-ins keeps core tools inline while MCP and extension tools stay on-demand.

descriptors.label: xd:// Inline Devices
descriptors.description: When xd:// Prompt Docs is Built-ins Only, inline dynamic devices whose names match these glob patterns (for example mcp__context_mode_*). Catalog Only ignores this setting.

descriptors.label: Auto QA
descriptors.description: Automated tool issue reporting (xd://report_issue). On by default; the first report asks for consent, and denying it disables reporting until re-enabled explicitly

descriptors.label: Auto QA Push Endpoint
descriptors.description: Full URL receiving Auto QA JSON reports (default https://qa.omp.sh/v1/grievances)

descriptors.label: LSP
descriptors.description: Enable the lsp tool for code intelligence (definitions, references, diagnostics, rename)

descriptors.label: Lazy LSP Startup
descriptors.description: Start language servers on first use (lsp tool or editing a matching file type) instead of at session startup

descriptors.label: Shared Language Servers
descriptors.description: Start language servers through the per-project daemon broker. Each connection gets its own server. While another omp instance in the project is running, a released server stays warm and the next connection reuses it instead of cold-starting (falls back to private servers when unavailable)

descriptors.label: Format on Write
descriptors.description: Automatically format code files using LSP after writing

descriptors.label: Diagnostics on Write
descriptors.description: Return LSP diagnostics after writing code files

descriptors.label: Diagnostics on Edit
descriptors.description: Return LSP diagnostics after editing code files

descriptors.label: Deduplicate Diagnostics
descriptors.description: Suppress post-edit LSP diagnostics already shown for a file; only surface new or changed ones

descriptors.label: Request Timeout
descriptors.description: Seconds to wait for a language server's diagnostics, hover and other answers when the agent sets no timeout; late post-edit diagnostics wait at least this long. Raise it for servers that are slow on a cold start. The lsp tool's timeout argument can still raise or lower it per call

descriptors.label: Bash
descriptors.description: Enable the bash tool for shell command execution

descriptors.label: Allow Compound Commands
descriptors.description: Evaluate literal && chains per command; unmatched commands use normal bash approval policy and mode

descriptors.label: Bash Auto-Background
descriptors.description: Automatically background long-running bash commands and deliver the result later

descriptors.label: Git Guard
descriptors.description: Refuse git commands that discard or move shared work in the bash tool: stash, reset --hard or to another commit, and checkout/switch/restore outside a merge or rebase conflict

descriptors.label: Bash Approval Patterns
descriptors.description: Ordered bash command approval rules. Each item has match and approval fields; only '*' wildcards are supported.

descriptors.label: Bash Interceptor
descriptors.description: Block shell commands that have dedicated tools

descriptors.label: direnv Auto-Load
descriptors.description: Auto-load a repo's direnv/devenv `.envrc` into the bash session so devenv tools and env vars are present without manual `direnv exec`. Honors direnv's allow list: an `.envrc` you haven't `direnv allow`ed is never executed

descriptors.label: direnv Load Timeout (ms)
descriptors.description: Max wait for the first `direnv export` (a cold devenv shell can be slow); on timeout the session runs without the direnv env

descriptors.label: Shell Minimizer
descriptors.description: Compress verbose shell output (git, npm, cargo, etc.) before returning it to the agent

descriptors.label: Shell Minimizer Source Outline
descriptors.description: Source outline mode for cat/read of source files: default or aggressive

descriptors.label: Python Eval Backend
descriptors.description: Allow the eval tool to dispatch Python cells to the IPython kernel

descriptors.label: JavaScript Eval Backend
descriptors.description: Allow the eval tool to dispatch JavaScript cells to the in-process runtime

descriptors.label: Eval Environment Provisioning
descriptors.description: Automatically create the managed JavaScript eval package environment on first install

descriptors.label: Eval-Defined Tools
descriptors.description: Let eval cells define tools (@tool in Python, tool(fn) in JS) that task, agent(), and workpool() subagents can call

descriptors.label: Fresh Workpool Agents
descriptors.description: Spawn a new subagent for every workpool item instead of reusing workers or batching queued items

descriptors.label: Eval Auto-Background
descriptors.description: Automatically background long-running eval cells and deliver the result later

descriptors.label: Python Kernel Mode
descriptors.description: Keep the IPython kernel alive across eval calls or start fresh each time

descriptors.label: Python Interpreter
descriptors.description: Optional path to an exact Python executable. When set, automatic Python runtime discovery is skipped.

descriptors.label: Allow Isolated Subagents
descriptors.description: Allow per-task isolation with `isolated: true`; tasks without it run in the shared checkout

descriptors.label: Isolation Backend
descriptors.description: Backend used for subagent isolation and worktree cloning

descriptors.label: Clone Checkout into Worktrees
descriptors.description: New worktrees from `github pr_checkout` and `git worktree add` in bash start as a copy-on-write clone of the current checkout so ignored build artifacts (node_modules, target) carry over; falls back to a plain checkout when the filesystem cannot clone

descriptors.label: Clean Source Checkout on /wt
descriptors.description: When creating a worktree with `/wt`, reset tracked changes and remove untracked files from the original checkout after carrying them over

descriptors.label: Worktree on Start
descriptors.description: Whether fresh interactive sessions start in a new linked worktree

descriptors.label: Worktree on Exit
descriptors.description: What to do on exit with worktrees created since omp started (on start or with `/wt`)

descriptors.label: Apply Isolated Changes
descriptors.description: Automatically apply successful isolated task changes to the parent checkout; disable to retain patch or branch artifacts

descriptors.label: Isolation Merge Strategy
descriptors.description: How isolated task changes are integrated (patch apply or branch merge)

descriptors.label: Isolation Commit Style
descriptors.description: Commit message style for nested repo changes (generic or AI-generated)

descriptors.label: Worktree Base Directory
descriptors.description: Base directory for agent-managed worktrees — task-isolation copies, `github` PR checkouts, and `omp worktree` cleanup all live here. Unset uses ~/.omp/wt. Must be an absolute or ~-relative path; relative paths are ignored. The OMP_WORKTREE_DIR env var overrides this.

descriptors.label: Prefer Task Delegation
descriptors.description: How strongly to push delegating work to subagents

descriptors.label: Batch Task Calls
descriptors.description: Switch the task tool to its batch shape: one call carries { context, tasks[] } — one subagent per item, with an optional per-item agent (defaulting to the session spawn-policy agent), per-item isolation, and a required shared context prepended to every assignment. With async.enabled=true, each spawn runs as an independent background agent with the normal idle/parked lifecycle; otherwise the call blocks for merged results. Disable to restore the flat single-spawn schema.

descriptors.label: Structured Task Results
descriptors.description: Expose outputSchema/schemaMode on the task tool and return subagent results through the yield tool, validated against caller or agent output schemas. Off: task subagents have no yield tool and return their final message as plain text, except agents whose definition sets structured: true. Eval agent()/workpool spawns always keep structured results.

descriptors.label: Speculative Task Launch
descriptors.description: Start each batch subagent as soon as its tasks[] item finishes streaming instead of waiting for the whole task call. Launched agents are aborted if the finished call fails validation, is blocked, or its arguments change. Requires auto-allowed task approval and no extension tool lifecycle handlers.

descriptors.label: Per-Task Effort
descriptors.description: Expose the optional effort parameter on task spawns, allowing callers to override each subagent's thinking level

descriptors.label: Max Concurrent Tasks
descriptors.description: Maximum number of subagents running concurrently

descriptors.label: LSP in Subagents
descriptors.description: Allow subagents spawned via the task tool to use the lsp tool. Off by default to keep subagents cheap; enable when LSP-aware delegation is worth the extra tokens.

descriptors.label: Max Task Recursion
descriptors.description: How many levels deep subagents can spawn their own subagents

descriptors.label: Max Subagent Runtime
descriptors.description: Hard wall-clock limit per subagent (ms). 0 disables it. Defense-in-depth against provider-side stream hangs that escape the inference-layer watchdog; triggers a normal subagent abort with a 'timed out' reason.

descriptors.label: Subagent Completion Probe
descriptors.description: Ask a working subagent, through a cached side request like /btw, to estimate how complete its task is: after 2, 5, 10 and 30 more minutes, then hourly. The estimate shows next to the subagent in wait and task views. Only subagents spawned by the main agent of an interactive session are asked; print, RPC, ACP and SDK runs never probe.

descriptors.label: Agent Idle TTL
descriptors.description: How long an idle subagent stays live in memory before being parked to disk (ms). Parked agents are revived automatically when messaged or resumed. 0 keeps idle agents live until exit.

descriptors.label: Soft Subagent Request Budget
descriptors.description: Soft per-subagent request budget (assistant requests per run). Crossing it injects a wrap-up steering notice (see task.softRequestBudgetNotice); at 1.5x the budget the run is force-stopped and the agent must hand back its partial findings. 0 disables the guard. Bundled scout/sonic agents cap out at a lower built-in budget, so a value below that cap still applies to them. A task.agentSoftRequestBudget entry replaces this budget for the agent it names.

descriptors.label: Soft Request Budget Notice
descriptors.description: Inject one steering notice when a subagent crosses its soft request budget, asking it to wrap up before the 1.5x forced-yield stop.

descriptors.label: Maximum Per-Spawn Effort
descriptors.description: Maximum reasoning effort allowed for the task tool's per-spawn effort hint. Lower values prevent callers from escalating subagents above this ceiling; the default preserves the model's full range.

descriptors.label: Generic Task Prewalk
descriptors.description: Arm prewalk for the bundled generic `task` subagent: it starts on its resolved model, plans and begins the implementation, then hands off to the 'smol' role at its first edit/write. Per-agent overrides (task.agentPrewalk, configured from the /agents hub) and user agent `prewalk` frontmatter apply regardless of this toggle.

descriptors.label: Show Resolved Model Badge
descriptors.description: Display the actual model ID used by each subagent in the task widget status line

descriptors.label: Plan Mode
descriptors.description: Enable plan mode for read-only exploration and planning before execution

descriptors.label: Start in Plan Mode
descriptors.description: Automatically enter plan mode at the start of every new session

descriptors.label: Autosave Plans
descriptors.description: Automatically save approved plans to disk when plan mode completes

descriptors.label: Autosave Directory
descriptors.description: Directory for autosaved plans. Supports ~, absolute, and cwd-relative paths. Empty uses <project>/.omp/plans/.

descriptors.label: Goal Mode
descriptors.description: Enable per-session goal mode and the hidden goal tool

descriptors.label: Goal Status in Footer
descriptors.description: Show token budget alongside the goal indicator in the status line

descriptors.label: Goal Continuation Modes
descriptors.description: Run modes where active goals may auto-continue between turns ("interactive", "rpc")

descriptors.label: Title Icons
descriptors.description: Icon and short code that head new generated or /rename session titles

descriptors.label: Title Generator
descriptors.description: What names an untitled session from the user's messages

descriptors.label: Refresh Title on Replan
descriptors.description: Refresh generated session titles after todo init replans unless the title was set by the user

descriptors.label: Skill Registry
descriptors.description: Skillshare registry used by `omp skill` to install, search, and publish skills (https://host[:port])

descriptors.label: Skill Commands
descriptors.description: Register skills as /skill:name commands

descriptors.label: Skill List Mode
descriptors.description: How the system prompt lists skills; every skill stays loadable via skill://<name>

descriptors.label: Claude User Commands
descriptors.description: Load commands from ~/.claude/commands/

descriptors.label: Claude Project Commands
descriptors.description: Load commands from .claude/commands/

descriptors.label: OpenCode User Commands
descriptors.description: Load commands from ~/.config/opencode/commands/

descriptors.label: OpenCode Project Commands
descriptors.description: Load commands from .opencode/commands/

descriptors.label: Tool Call Handler Timeout (ms)
descriptors.description: Positive finite active-work timeout for extension tool_call handlers; invalid values use 30000ms, and time awaiting OMP-owned dialogs does not count

descriptors.label: Exa
descriptors.description: Enable the Exa web search provider

descriptors.label: Exa Search Delay
descriptors.description: Minimum delay between Exa web search requests in milliseconds; set 0 to disable pacing

descriptors.label: SearXNG Endpoint
descriptors.description: Base URL of a self-hosted SearXNG instance used for web search

descriptors.label: Browser
descriptors.description: Enable the browser eval prelude for scripted Chromium automation (Puppeteer)

descriptors.label: Browser CDP URL
descriptors.description: Default HTTP CDP discovery endpoint (for example http://127.0.0.1:9222) to attach to instead of launching a browser. Explicit app.cdp_url or app.path on the tool call take precedence.

descriptors.label: Browser Relay
descriptors.description: Drive your own Chrome tabs through the omp browser relay. Install the extension once (`omp browser-relay install`); the relay server auto-starts when the browser prelude needs it. Takes precedence over Browser CDP URL; set PI_BROWSER_RELAY=0 or PI_BROWSER_RELAY=1 to override.

descriptors.label: Browser Relay URL
descriptors.description: omp browser relay endpoint (default http://127.0.0.1:9224).

descriptors.label: Headless Browser
descriptors.description: Launch browser in headless mode (disable to show browser UI)

descriptors.label: cmux Browser
descriptors.description: Use cmux WKWebView surfaces for browser automation when a cmux socket is available. Set PI_BROWSER_CMUX=0 or PI_BROWSER_CMUX=1 to override.

descriptors.label: Tern Browser
descriptors.description: Inside a Tern pane, open browser tabs as picture-in-pictures over omp's pane (native web view) instead of headless Chromium; falls back to Chromium when no Tern window can host them. Explicit app options, the relay and Browser CDP URL take precedence; app.tern:false opts one open out. Set PI_BROWSER_TERN=0 or PI_BROWSER_TERN=1 to override.

descriptors.label: Freeze Browser Tabs On Turn End
descriptors.description: Freeze OMP-owned headless browser tabs when a turn settles so animated pages stop burning CPU/GPU while idle. Tabs unfreeze automatically on next use; pass persist:true on open to opt a tab out.

descriptors.label: Browser Idle Close Timeout
descriptors.description: Close OMP-owned headless browser tabs and Tern browser picture-in-pictures idle longer than this many seconds (0 = never; session dispose still reaps). Never touches relay/CDP/spawned browsers or other sessions' tabs.

descriptors.label: Screenshot Directory
descriptors.description: Directory to save screenshots. If unset, screenshots go to a temp file. Supports ~. Examples: ~/Downloads, ~/Desktop, /sdcard/Download (Android)

descriptors.label: IDA Pro
descriptors.description: Open executables read with `read` in IDA Pro (idalib) and enable the `ida` tool; inert when no IDA install is found

descriptors.label: IDA Python
descriptors.description: Python interpreter that can import ida_domain and idapro; empty auto-detects

descriptors.label: IDA Install Dir
descriptors.description: Directory containing libidalib, exported as IDADIR; empty auto-detects ($IDADIR, ida-config.json, standard install paths)

descriptors.label: IDA Max Open Databases
descriptors.description: Most IDA databases (omp.ida.* daemons in omp ps) open at once per project; opening another saves and closes the least recently used idle one

descriptors.label: IDA Idle Close Timeout
descriptors.description: Save and close IDA databases idle longer than this many seconds (0 = never); the exec namespace resets on reopen

descriptors.label: MCP Project Config
descriptors.description: Load .mcp.json/mcp.json from project root

descriptors.label: MCP Startup Window
descriptors.description: Wait this many milliseconds for initial MCP tool discovery; 0 waits until connections settle

descriptors.label: MCP Markdown Results
descriptors.description: Render non-JSON MCP text results as Markdown in the transcript

descriptors.label: MCP Update Injection
descriptors.description: Inject MCP resource updates into the agent conversation

descriptors.label: MCP Notification Debounce
descriptors.description: Debounce window in milliseconds for MCP resource updates before injecting them into the conversation

descriptors.label: Serve Images as URLs
descriptors.description: Publish outgoing images through the configured backend chain and send URL-fetching providers short URLs instead of inline base64. Falls back to inline automatically when every backend or a provider fetch fails

descriptors.label: Image URL Backends
descriptors.description: Ordered destinations tried when publishing images for provider access

descriptors.label: Image Upload Command
descriptors.description: Argv template for the command backend; {file} is the image path, {mime}/{ext} optional. The last URL printed on stdout is used (e.g. pasta -b -f {file})

descriptors.label: Image URL Public Base
descriptors.description: Externally reachable base URL fronting the blob server (required for ssh, optional for direct)

descriptors.label: Image URL Lifetime (hours)
descriptors.description: Serving window for locally hosted image URLs, measured from the last time a conversation sent them; resuming a conversation re-arms the window at the same link. 0 keeps links alive while the broker runs

descriptors.label: Image URL Bind Host
descriptors.description: Host the blob server binds to; loopback for tunnels, 0.0.0.0 for direct serving

descriptors.label: Image URL SSH Target
descriptors.description: user@host destination for the ssh reverse forward

descriptors.label: Image URL SSH Remote Port
descriptors.description: Remote listen port of the ssh reverse forward that your web server proxies to

descriptors.label: Hide Secrets
descriptors.description: Obfuscate configured secrets and redact credential-shaped tokens before sending to AI providers

descriptors.label: Speech-to-Text
descriptors.description: Enable speech-to-text input via microphone

descriptors.label: Speech-to-Text Submit Trigger
descriptors.description: Choose when speech dictation automatically submits: Never, Release (2+ words), Release with complete sentence, or When I Say Submit.

descriptors.label: Relay URL
descriptors.description: Relay used by /collab (wss://host[:port])

descriptors.label: Web UI URL
descriptors.description: Browser UI used by /collab links; empty derives from collab.relayUrl; explicit http:// is localhost-only

descriptors.label: Display Name
descriptors.description: Name shown to other collab participants (default: OS username)

descriptors.label: Auto Start
descriptors.description: Host every interactive session via collab.relayUrl as it starts and publish it to the local registry (omp collab list); rooms rotate on session switch

descriptors.label: Share Server
descriptors.description: Share viewer/upload base used by /share (encrypted blob upload + viewer; links are <base>/<id>#<key>)

descriptors.label: Share Store
descriptors.description: Where /share uploads the encrypted session blob

descriptors.label: Share Secret Redaction
descriptors.description: Run the secret obfuscator over /share snapshots before upload (uses the secrets.* config)

descriptors.label: Stream Server
descriptors.description: Live stream server used by `omp stream` (https://host[:port]); viewers watch at <base>/<your Stencil username>

descriptors.label: Extra Redaction Patterns
descriptors.description: Additional regular expressions redacted from every streamed row, on top of env/secrets.yml values and built-in credential shapes
